An experienced CEO, executive director and Board trustee/NED. I am a strong motivational leader and transformation and systems specialist, with deep domain health and social care expertise.  My strategic, operational and governance skillset has been consolidated during a successful 30-year career in the public, private and voluntary sectors. 

I have worked in multiple NHS director positions and as CEO for social care charities and a private sector start-up, holding executive portfolios in strategy, business development, workforce, change management, commissioning and service delivery. This breadth of experience has equipped me with a unique, cross-disciplinary perspective which enables me to streamline business transformation, improve efficiency and reduce costs in a range of organisations, where I have been accountable for £MM budgets. 

In the course of my career I have headed senior professional and clinical teams and managed from 30 to over 1,000 employees, creating cohesive staff relations and building capability to drive strong business growth. I steer an effective path between strategic and tactical objectives, embedding continuous improvement strategies that align with corporate priorities and realise business goals. 

I believe that organisational success relies on the ability to nurture and exploit innovation and I use keen business intelligence to spot and grasp new opportunities. I have played instrumental leadership roles in winning major competitive tenders, securing sizeable grants and awards to support business development and service integration and  producing compelling business cases for new service models and developments. 

My in-depth knowledge of the health, charity and medical sectors was substantially enhanced by an NIHR-funded Fellowship at the University of Bristol in 2011 – 2012. This focused on knowledge mobilisation and the application of evidence from health services research into the commissioning and provision of health services.

I am dedicated to improving health and wellbeing, increasing life chances and addressing inequalities for people and communities at regional and national level. I am always keen to make connections within the health and social care sector and with leaders working across civil society.

I’m the Chief People Officer at DAS UK - part of the ARAG Group. As an integral part of the executive team and FCA-approved person, I play a key role in delivering the business strategy whilst building a culture where people feel engaged, included and have a sense of belonging.

Over the last 25 years, I have created agile HR functions, optimised L&D, talent, remuneration and reward programmes, enhanced employee relations and stakeholder engagement (including Unions), built cultures which are inclusive and engaging, as well as directing radical organisational and cultural change. Additionally, I have led on significant M&A and restructuring projects. 

Having built trusted relationships and multinational networks throughout my career, I understand what it takes to establish progressive business models, develop cohesive teams and maximise performance. I thrive on finding practical, innovative solutions to business challenges; implementing change to modernise and transform cultures, as well as supporting and developing employees to deliver beyond their expectations, achieve recognition, and drive businesses forward. 

With diverse industry sector experience in food retail, technology, engineering, financial services and private equity through roles at Tesco Plc, AXA UK, Invensys Rail Group, ING Direct and Brightside, I bring a wealth of HR knowledge, influence and gravitas to the Executive table that enables me to constructively shape corporate thinking and strategy.

I provide focus and clarity to decision-making and build strong stakeholder relationships through aligning values and belief structures to corporate objectives, appreciating different points of view and finding ways forward.

In more recent years, personal circumstances have resulted in me becoming a significant supporter and champion of cancer charities especially CRUK where I am actively involved in a number of their initiatives, all aimed at raising funds for vital life saving/life prolonging research.
